name: hub-home-design-gaps
goal: The signed-in Hub home matches the approved hub-home designs: empty-state panels with next steps, CS initials, counted quota warnings with one almost-out callout, quota dialog status and add-subscription tile, quick replies, phone chat header, counted dialog summaries, weekday headings and plan state pills.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Side-by-side of 146 built screenshots (hub-home.spec.ts, TAKE_SCREENSHOT) against specification/designs/hub-home/screens on main e6ad8ee083 showed: empty cards drew a currentColor dashed border with no next step; Chief of Staff avatar read CO; Quota card showed bare RUNNING LOW text and repeated Almost out lines; Quota dialog had a generic summary, no per-subscription status, no Add a subscription tile and countdown-only resets; no quick replies; phone chat header stayed Agents; Plans/Scheduled/Projects dialog summaries were generic; schedule days lacked weekdays; plan status chips were not state pills.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: hub-home.spec.ts captures screenshots and asserts headings, dialog fit and chat delivery, but never compares copy, empty-state actions, initials, quota counts or dialog summaries with the design, and the empty panel border was never checked against the text colour. New hub-home-design.spec.ts asserts those rendered behaviours in a browser (relations, not CSS strings), and hub-home-presentation.test.ts covers the formatting helpers.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red failed at 350c613c87 (unit: quickReplies is not a function, 5/5 failing). Browser: hub-home-design.spec.ts 5/5 failed with main's packages/hub/src restored. Pill alignment guard failed by 781px without the quota-modal.css rule.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 01e5fa6af5: Hub home components, presentation helpers and two CSS rules; unit manifests reindexed with descriptions. No changes to Tracker, Desktop or shared Reports code.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed at 01e5fa6af5 with the unchanged unit command. Browser: hub-home-design.spec.ts 5/5, hub-home.spec.ts 32/32 and hosted-home.spec.ts pass (46/46 dev server); 37/37 against the built Cloudflare worker (HARNESS_VERIFY=1).

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: At 87c3163a70: Hub browser hub-home-design 5/5 + hub-home 32/32 + hosted-home (46/46 dev), 37/37 built worker; fresh screenshots inspected against all 146 design PNGs, 12 pairs in specification/designs/hub-home/verification. Hub 559 unit, svelte-check 0 errors, build, harness audit pass; eslint only the unchanged hub.config.hub-env.test.ts error shared with main. Root audit passes; units check has no stale registry and no Hub home findings. Reports component catalog: 48/48 Hub home entries pass.
